disclaimer: Starter formulations are reference guides published by third parties (NuSil CareSil™, 2013). Silitex substitutions are catalog cross-references for lab evaluation only — not Silitex-validated formulas. Verify each substitution on the Silitex TDS/SDS.

Phenyl Trimethicone.silitex: Silitex DM Series (dimethicone 50–350 cSt) — functional alternative; phenyl fluid: ask Silitex lab
Phenyl Trimethicone.note: No phenyl-modified fluid in the current extract. DM fluids give slip and water barrier; refractive-index match needs Silitex confirmation.

Cyclopentasiloxane.silitex: Silitex CM 040 / Volatile D5 Fluid (identical) — D5-free: Silitex DM 5 / DM 10 (low-viscosity linear dimethicone)
Cyclopentasiloxane.note: For REACH-sensitive cosmetics prefer DM 5/10 or reduce to <0.1% cyclics; see REACH banner.

Cyclopentasiloxane (and) Dimethicone Cro.silitex: Silitex SG 9040 (D5 carrier) or SG 9041 / Velvet Gel D5-free (dimethicone carrier)
Cyclopentasiloxane (and) Dimethicone Cro.note: Same crosspolymer gel function: silky feel, thickening, oil-phase structure.

Cyclopentasiloxane (and) Cyclohexasiloxa.silitex: Silitex SG 9040 / SG 9041 Velvet Gel (D5-free version recommended)
Cyclopentasiloxane (and) Cyclohexasiloxa.note: D5/D6 carrier blend → replace with dimethicone-carrier gel for REACH.

notebooklm_prompt: You are a cosmetic formulation chemist. From the sources in this notebook (supplier formulation guides, TDS, SDS), extract every STARTER FORMULATION for personal care / cosmetics and output ONE JSON array. For each formulation give: id, code (supplier reference), name, category (e.g. 'Personal care · face'), type (O/W, W/O, anhydrous, gel, serum…), source (document + date), hero_ingredient (the silicone that defines the formula and its function), claims (array), properties {appearance, viscosity, ph, stability}, procedure (array of steps in order), phases (array of {phase, rows:[[INCI name, wt%, trade name / supplier], …]}). Keep INCI names exact, percentages numeric, sum ≈ 100. Then add silicone_ingredients: for every silicone INCI used, list its trade name, supplier, function in the formula, and whether it contains cyclic siloxanes (D4/D5/D6). Do not invent values; write null where the source is silent. Output JSON only.
